defs.meaning: 预测，预言（prediction 复数形式）

examples.en: Many of his predictions are coming true.
examples.zh: 他的许多预言都在成为现实。

examples.en: These results accord closely with our predictions.
examples.zh: 这些结果和我们的预测相当一致。

examples.en: Their predictions turned out to be wide of the mark.
examples.zh: 他们的预测后来发现太离谱了。
